1cd2d368-2fc5-4115-882f-e30948a597e4.Text: Ends the turn. Costs 1 AP. Pick the direction you expect the enemy from. Until the start of your next turn, make one quick reaction attack with your weapon against the first enemy that moves, is pushed or acts within your weapon's range, in any direction. Its hit chance is your own (distance, cover and talents still apply), scaled down by how far you have to swing to fire: all of it dead ahead, down to a tenth of it a quarter-turn away or more. It deals 33% of your weapon's damage. Taking damage before it fires cancels it.

0b6da7d3-83c9-4576-8768-2708508ed113.Text: Ends the turn. Costs 1 AP, 2 with a Heavy weapon. Aim a cone: the farther you aim, the longer and narrower it gets, up to your weapon's range. Until the start of your next turn, attack enemies that move, are pushed or act inside it: one shot for each attack your weapon could have made with the Action Points left after casting it, at most 2. When it fires, it shoots the enemy that set it off, then at once the next-closest enemy marked Overwatched; an enemy already shot at is only attacked again after it moves at least 2 cells. Attacks use your weapon's normal hit chance, with a snap-shot penalty from -1 at the shortest reach to -15 at your weapon's range, on top of the normal range penalty. Its shots count as attacks of opportunity, so attack-of-opportunity talents apply. Taking damage ends it.

4bd455eb-f1a0-4754-abb6-d18063a5d139.Text: Ends the turn. Costs 1 AP, 2 with a Heavy weapon. Pin down the target until the start of your next turn: each time it leaves its square, by moving, charging, jumping or being pushed, you make a ranged attack of opportunity against it, using your weapon's normal hit chance. A long move draws one attack, not one per square. It can stay where it is and act without drawing fire. While Suppressed, the target's own ranged attacks have their hit chance reduced by a quarter. Taking damage ends the suppression.

bc63cd4b-4de3-49f9-bf67-09992c124939.Text: Pinned down. Each time this unit leaves its square, by moving, charging, jumping or being pushed, the suppressing attacker makes a ranged attack of opportunity against it. Its own ranged attacks have their hit chance reduced by a quarter. Ends if the suppressor takes damage.

8e4f3ee9-93af-4e5c-9262-9b76604ff0b2.Text: Watching a cone. Each rank is one shot left at enemies that move, are pushed or act inside it.

640228ad-add2-44c5-a92a-9baaaceb3c43.Text: Standing in an Overwatch cone. Each rank is one point of penalty to the hit chance of a shot from that cone (1 to 15, growing with how far the cone reaches), on top of its normal range penalty.
